title: Apply for a native animal keeper licence
summary: This page provides information on how to apply for a native animal keeper licence for over 300 types of native animals in NSW.
intro:
This licence covers over 300 types of native animals listed on the NSW Native Animal Keepers' Species List as class 1 or basic:

Licences are granted under the Biodiversity Conservation Act 2016.

For details on licence fees and duration visit the Environment and Heritage website .
who_can_apply: Must be over 16 years of age.
what_you_need: A physical Australian driver licence card (front and back). Digital licences are not accepted.
An Australian photo card (front and back).
A passport and a proof of address document issued in the last 3 months.
An ADF Photo ID and a proof of address document issued in the last 3 months.
An uploaded copy of one of the following proof of identity.

how_to_steps.text: Identify the species code using the NSW Native Animal Keepers' Species List.
Use the 'Apply online' button on this page to go the form.
Log in or create a MyServiceNSW account.
Follow the steps to apply for a native animal keeper licence.
You'll get a transaction receipt within 4 hours of applying.
You'll be notified of the outcome of your application within 28 days.
